title: privilegecheckerlog
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): CheckedPrivilege, CheckedUser, createdby, createdonbehalfby, ImpersonatingUser, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, PrivilegeCheckerRunId, SupportingCaller.

checktype.description: The type of authorization check that was done.

createdon.description: Date and time when the record was created.

importsequencenumber.description: Sequence number of the import that created this record.

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the record was modified.

overriddencreatedon.description: Date and time that the record was migrated.

privilegedepth.description: Depth that was checked for the privilege.

request.description: A brief description of the web request.

statecode.description: Status of the Privilege checker log

statuscode.description: Reason for the status of the Privilege checker log

utcconversiontimezonecode.description: Time zone code that was in use when the record was created.

_checkeduser_value.description: The user whose privilege was checked.

_createdby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who created the record.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the record.

_impersonatinguser_value.description: If this was an impersonation, this will give who was impersonating -- in this case, their privilege was also checked.

_modifiedby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who modified the record.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who modified the record.

_privilegecheckerrunid_value.description: Privilege Checker Run for this log

_supportingcaller_value.description: If this was a flow execution, this will give who was the owner of the flow -- in this case, their privilege was also checked.
